actionId.description: Id of the action that needs attention

key.description:
Lock key. Note, this key should be unique within the app
{@see Lock#key} to set this field

doNotWait.description:
If set, then attempt to lock will be tried exactly once and will not wait for {@link #timeout} seconds.
This will also set {@link #doNotThrowOnFailure} to true since it simulates a tryLock which returns true / false

alreadyLockedErrorMessage.description: If set, then any lock failure will throw this message.

maxRetries.description:
Maximum number of times attempts to acquire a lock will be made . This means that it will run at most 1 + maxRetries
times including the initial attempt

doNotThrowOnFailure.description:
If set, no error will be thrown if failed to acquire lock in desired time {@link timeout}
{@see Lock#doNotThrowOnFailure} to set this field

heartbeat.description:
Periodic heartbeat check to see if lock should continue be held or cleaned up. By default, the scope of the lock will be until
the action calling to acquire the lock is alive
{@see Lock#heartbeat} to set this field

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

title: Holds entries for database based locking
name: DbLockEntry
